title: Business Analyst (TAX)
description:
Business Analyst (TAX)


***Add resume in English***


Activities:


• Serves as a Tax, Sourcing, Travel, Expense, and Real Estate applications subject matter expert associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient.

• Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders and technology staff, including off-shore personnel, to ensure that communication is open and ongoing.

• Serves as a liaison between technical and functional stakeholders and project management teams to keep initiatives moving forward smoothly and in accordance with project plans.

• Defines project scope, project strategy, deliverable priorities, and recommend alternative solutions.

• Define detailed requirements, analyze business needs, and validate solutions with the internal partners.

• Coordinate project activities, prepare agendas, document meeting outcomes, and collaborate with team members.

• Establish, administer, and maintain project and knowledge management processes and tools.

• Ensure applications are compliant with IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.

• Evaluate SOC reports to ensure vendor and application compliance and surface risks.


Requirements:

• Advanced English.

• Relevant experience working with Tax, Sourcing, Shared Services, Travel, Expense, or Real Estate applications.

• Application configuration, design, and interface experience.

• Experience working with third party vendors to implement SaaS solutions.

• Working "hands-on" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies.

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes, including but not limited to Tax, Procurement, Accounts Payable, Travel & Expense, and Real Estate.

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project.

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of full-stack software development experience and a background in React.js and React Native, as well as C#, C++, or .NET, to join our U.S. client's engineering team. In this role, you will utilize excellent problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, as well as patience and a customer-friendly attitude, while working in a team environment.

The right candidate is someone who:

  • Solves problems
  • Enjoys diving into and modernizing a 30-year-old product
  • Drives high-quality industry and team standards
  • Loves learning new processes, terminology, concepts, and code
  • Displays a deep curiosity about how banking institutions function


Our client is a U.S. fintech software company that provides innovative banking solutions to enhance operations and improve members' financial lives. The company has grown steadily since its inception over thirty years ago, with nearly 300 financial institutions across the United States, U.S. territories, and the Caribbean as customers. Backed by a large private equity company, our client is a recognized market leader helmed by financial industry veterans.


Responsibilities

  • Modernize and transform the client's existing software and write new features for the client's customers
  • Document the client's processes, products, and APIs
  • Assist with software releases and ensure we remain on schedule
  • Participate in story pointing and estimation activities
  • Review code and provide feedback, as well as participate in pair programming
  • Be an Agile Scrum advocate
  • Write and maintain automated tests using tools such as Jest, Jasmine, Cypress, Telerik Test Studio, and Grafana k6


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Experience with the React Framework and React Native or equivalent JavaScript frameworks
  • Experience with a primary back-end language, such as C#, C++, or .NET
  • Experience working with databases, such as Progress OpenEdge, MySQL, Cassandra, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL
  • Background with Agile Scrum
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work well cross-functionally
  • A strong product sense, a high degree of empathy for internal and external users, and a desire to seek feedback from the same users about your work
  • Understanding of development ergonomics, taking pride in understanding your engineering customers
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and gets excited about collaboration to define complex problems better, determine solutions, and then execute on them
  • The ability to strike a balance between speed and quality of features to create durable technology. You thrive on building scalable systems that are robust, resilient to failure, and easy to maintain.
  • A practice of keeping up with industry trends and assessing new technologies that can help solve problems better
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Regional Data Visualization & BI Specialist
description:
Esta posición es clave para traducir datos en historias comprensibles a través de dashboards interactivos y efectivos. Como Data Visualization & BI Specialist serás responsable de diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards enfocados en la toma de decisiones para un cliente estratégico de IPG Mediabrands. Colaborarás estrechamente con ingenieros de datos, project managers y equipos de cliente para definir soluciones de visualización que generen impacto. Esta posición reporta directamente al Regional BI Manager y forma parte de una red regional comprometida con elevar el estándar de nuestras capacidades en visualización.




Responsabilidades clave


  • Diseñar y desarrollar dashboards efectivos y atractivos utilizando PowerBI principalmente.
  • Transformar y preparar datos utilizando Power Query desde diversas fuentes como BigQuery, APIs y archivos planos.
  • Desarrollar métricas complejas y cálculos con DAX alineados a los objetivos del cliente.
  • Administrar, actualizar y optimizar dashboards en producción, resolviendo incidentes en colaboración con los equipos técnicos.
  • Colaborar con Data Engineers para definir modelos de datos que respalden las necesidades de visualización.
  • Capacitar a usuarios finales y promover las mejores prácticas de visualización dentro del cliente y del equipo interno.
  • Documentar procesos y soluciones para asegurar escalabilidad y reutilización.
  • Contribuir al desarrollo y evolución de nuestras capacidades de visualización en instancias locales y regionales.


Cualificaciones Esenciales


  • +5 años de experiencia comprobable diseñando dashboards en PowerBI, con un portafolio sólido que demuestre excelencia visual y analítica.
  • Dominio de Power Query para tareas de transformación de datos.
  • Sólidos conocimientos en DAX para la creación de KPIs y lógica analítica.
  • Conocimientos en modelado de datos y principios de UX/UI aplicados a visualización.
  • Manejo de BigQuery y lenguaje SQL.
  • Habilidad para comunicar resultados a públicos técnicos y no técnicos.
  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos ágiles.



Habilidades y características deseadas


  • Experiencia previa en la industria de medios o publicidad, especialmente en canales digitales como redes sociales o publicidad programática. (NO EXCLUYENTE)
  • Conocimiento en administración de espacios de trabajo en PowerBI y optimización de rendimiento.
  • Pasión por la innovación, iniciativa para aprender nuevas tecnologías de BI y compartir conocimientos con el equipo.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Web Designer
description:
We’re looking for an experienced and creative Web Designer to join our fully remote team to work on a variety of projects for our clients across the globe.


Overview


Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency based in San Francisco, California with a growing distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end design, production and strategy services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

From one-off-digital projects to full website designs, no two Wunderdogs jobs are the same: if you’re a creative who enjoys variety in what you do the diverse nature of our work is sure to keep you on your toes. We’re looking for a designer excited by the opportunity to support our team on our digital creative and elevate our work to the next level.


Websites form a core part of our business therefore a passion for and extensive experience in web design is a must. Our ideal candidate will have a strong visual sense, an analytical mind, a good eye for detail and the portfolio to back it up.


We’re looking for someone who does not shy away from a challenge and is comfortable working to tight deadlines when required. You will be joining us during an exciting time and will be working on multiple projects simultaneously, often for different clients. Our team is entrepreneurial, smart, hard working and fun - Wunderdogs is a challenging yet very rewarding workplace, one where your effort and passion can make a real difference to our clients.


Your key day-to-day responsibilities will include


  • Conceptualizing creative ideas with clients
  • Testing and improving the design of the website
  • Establishing design guidelines, standards, and best practices
  • Maintaining the appearance of websites by enforcing content standards
  • Designing visual imagery for websites and ensuring that they are in line with branding for clients.
  • Effectively communicate your designs to developers and other key stakeholders
  • Address product, marketing and business needs
  • Conduct industry research and stay up-to-date on best practices, competitor UI designs and emerging technologies
  • Facilitate web workshops for our clients
  • Create lo-fi wireframes and high-fidelity designs in Figma
  • Develop design systems, design websites using brand guidelines
  • Communicate with clients and attend client meetings
  • Collaborate with developers to design new and intuitive user experiences
  • Interact with our development and management teams to collaborate on pitches and strategies


The Qualifications


  • 4-5 years of design industry experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design or similar field and a strong portfolio of digital projects
  • Fluent across the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Understanding of design systems and how to create them
  • Understanding of Figma and how to use it
  • Great communication skills: whether it’s talking through your work with the team or speaking with clients, you’ll need to be able to get your point across and empathize with those of others
  • Experience creating products with complex user flows and high-quality UI design is a plus
  • Experience running stakeholder workshops with clients
  • Ability to work at least 3-4 business hours in Pacific Standard Time
  • Self-motivation in a remote professional environment and ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Sharp attention to detail within a fast-paced work environment


The Perks


  • Diverse team and interesting projects from all over the globe
  • KPI-based yearly bonus
  • Fully remote job (traveling is encouraged)
  • Highly cooperative team that encourages professional growth and self-development
  • Salary is commensurate with experience


How to apply


To be considered, send your cover letter, CV, case studies, portfolio, references and any supporting materials to

Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency based in San Francisco, California with a growing distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. title: Full Stack Developer "982043"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Angular no front-end.
  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar bancos de dados SQL para dar suporte à funcionalidade das aplicações.
  • Criar e manter APIs em Python , garantindo integração eficiente entre o front-end e o back-end.
  • Utilizar o Azure Data Factory para integração e transformação de dados.
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais para definir, desenhar e implementar novas funcionalidades.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e debug em toda a stack de desenvolvimento.
  • Assegurar a performance, qualidade e responsividade das aplicações.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias do setor, buscando melhorias contínuas nos processos de desenvolvimento.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada como Full Stack Developer ou função similar.
  • Forte proficiência em Angular para desenvolvimento front-end.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e administração de bancos de dados SQL .
  • Proficiência em Python para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com Azure Data Factory .
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de controle de versão (ex: GitHub).
  • Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).
  • Inglês avançado


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem (Azure, AWS).
  • Conhecimento em outros frameworks front-end (React, Vue.js).
  • Entendimento de práticas DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD .


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: [Remote] Senior Software Engineer (Java)
description:
Location: Remote (New Zealand time zone overlap preferred)

Type: Contractor / Full-Time

Hours: Flexible, with at least 3–4 hours of overlap with NZT (18h-22h BRT)

Start Date: Immediate


About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience in Java and strong working knowledge of Node.js and Python . This role goes beyond traditional development—you’ll be expected to embrace AI as part of your daily toolkit , using it to improve efficiency, generate insights, and accelerate delivery.


You’ll work across a variety of projects, including green-field builds where you’ll own architecture and design decisions, collaborating directly with clients to shape solutions from concept through delivery.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and deliver scalable, secure, and performant solutions in green-field and ongoing projects.
  • Build applications in Java, Node.js and Python .
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, AI debugging tools, etc) to speed up development, improve documentation, and optimise workflows.
  • Collaborate directly with clients to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and deliver value.
  • Define engineering best practices, technical roadmaps, and solution design standards.
  • Mentor engineers and foster a culture of experimentation, quality, and continuous learning.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of professional experience in software engineering with strong Java expertise.
  • Working knowledge of Node.js and Python .
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering green-field projects.
  • Strong grasp of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Comfortable and proactive in using AI tools for coding, documentation, testing, and prototyping .
  • Excellent communication skills in English, written and spoken.
  • Ability to work directly with clients in a consultative and collaborative manner.


Desirable

  • Experience in high-autonomy/startup environments.
  • Familiarity with microservices, Docker/Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Exposure to AI/ML project work (bonus but not required).


What we offer

  • International projects with heavy use of AI-assisted workflows.
  • A role where you can architect solutions from the ground up.
  • Flexible, remote work environment built on trust.
  • A small, collaborative, and forward-thinking technical team.
  • Real opportunities to influence product direction and company decisions.


Company Description

TechVantage Solutions is a New Zealand-based software consultancy specializing in software development outsourcing and engineering team augmentation. We empower businesses from fast-moving startups to global enterprises to build, scale, and deliver high-quality software with speed and confidence. We have partnered with companies around the world, including those serving Fortune 500 clients, to solve complex technical challenges and accelerate delivery. At TechVantage, we bridge the gap between business and technology, delivering scalable, world-class solutions from New Zealand.

title: Desenvolvimento de Negócios Globais - Especialistas em Varejo
description:
Se você já liderou no varejo - na loja ou na sede - queremos falar com você.


Sim, somos uma empresa de tecnologia.


Não, você não precisa ter experiência em tecnologia.


Na STOREE.AI, criamos uma plataforma que permite que os gerentes se dupliquem em uma versão com inteligência artificial - um gêmeo digital capaz de liderar equipes, atribuir tarefas, acompanhar KPIs e treinar colaboradores.


Já somos utilizados por mais de 100 redes de lojas.


A tecnologia funciona.


Agora precisamos de pessoas que entendem de varejo para ajudar outros a entender como fazer isso funcionar para eles.


Por que a experiência em varejo é importante:


Nossa plataforma é ampla - ela pode fazer muita coisa.


Mas o que funciona bem para uma rede pode ser completamente diferente para outra.


Uma rede de cosméticos precisa de ferramentas diferentes das de um supermercado.


Um diretor de VM enxerga valor em funcionalidades diferentes das que importam para um head de RH ou de operações.


É por isso que não queremos vendedores.


Queremos profissionais de varejo que possam:


  • Entender as necessidades de uma rede
  • Guiá-los na criação do seu próprio gestor com IA
  • Ajudar nosso time interno a posicionar a solução certa para cada marca
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não jargões tecnológicos


Este é um desenvolvimento de negócios com profundidade - porque conhecer o varejo é o que faz tudo isso funcionar.


O que você vai realmente fazer:


  • Construir uma carteira de varejistas relevantes
  • Usar nossas ferramentas de IA (nós te ensinamos) para iniciar conversas
  • Explicar como a STOREE.AI resolve os desafios específicos de cada negócio
  • Guiar o processo ou repassá-lo para nosso time quando necessário
  • Ajudar a moldar o ajuste do produto internamente - você será nosso olhar de varejo


Você não vai fazer pitch.

Vai conectar, guiar e traduzir entre dois mundos.


Para quem é essa oportunidade:


  • Líderes distritais e regionais
  • Profissionais de sede nas áreas de operações, treinamento, RH, marketing ou excelência no varejo
  • Pessoas que lideraram operações de loja, VM ou experiência do cliente
  • Qualquer pessoa que entende como gerenciar lojas - e quer dar o próximo passo na carreira


Se você já disse: “A tecnologia não entende como é a realidade aqui na ponta” - nós concordamos.


É por isso que queremos você do nosso lado.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessária experiência em tecnologia
  • Trabalho remoto, com horários flexíveis
  • Comissões por resultados + possibilidade de efetivação em tempo integral
  • Trabalhar com uma empresa prestes a escalar globalmente
  • Fazer parte de algo real - nada de teoria


Isso não é um emprego. É a sua segunda carreira.

De especialista em varejo a líder em tecnologia.

De gerenciar equipes a liderar transformações.

Queremos profissionais de varejo que possam:


  • Entender as necessidades de uma rede
  • Guiá-los na criação do seu próprio gestor com IA
  • Ajudar nosso time interno a posicionar a solução certa para cada marca
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não jargões tecnológicos


Este é um desenvolvimento de negócios com profundidade - porque conhecer o varejo é o que faz tudo isso funcionar.


O que você vai realmente fazer:


  • Construir uma carteira de varejistas relevantes
  • Usar nossas ferramentas de IA (nós te ensinamos) para iniciar conversas
  • Explicar como a STOREE.AI resolve os desafios específicos de cada negócio
  • Guiar o processo ou repassá-lo para nosso time quando necessário
  • Ajudar a moldar o ajuste do produto internamente - você será nosso olhar de varejo


Você não vai fazer pitch.

Vai conectar, guiar e traduzir entre dois mundos.


Para quem é essa oportunidade:


  • Líderes distritais e regionais
  • Profissionais de sede nas áreas de operações, treinamento, RH, marketing ou excelência no varejo
  • Pessoas que lideraram operações de loja, VM ou experiência do cliente
  • Qualquer pessoa que entende como gerenciar lojas - e quer dar o próximo passo na carreira


Se você já disse: “A tecnologia não entende como é a realidade aqui na ponta” - nós concordamos.


É por isso que queremos você do nosso lado.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessária experiência em tecnologia
  • Trabalho remoto, com horários flexíveis
  • Comissões por resultados + possibilidade de efetivação em tempo integral
  • Trabalhar com uma empresa prestes a escalar globalmente
  • Fazer parte de algo real - nada de teoria


Isso não é um emprego. É a sua segunda carreira.

De especialista em varejo a líder em tecnologia.

De gerenciar equipes a liderar transformações.


Acesse nosso site:

- O que você deve ter?


  • +4 anos de experiência em design digital, com portfólio demonstrando projetos end-to-end.
  • Fluência em Espanhol (oral e escrito) para conduzir pesquisas e apresentações com usuários e stakeholders.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de jornadas do usuário E2E.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Especialista SAP ABAP e FIORI
description:
Who we are

At Amaris Consulting , we are an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. We partner with more than 1,000 clients worldwide, delivering expertise across multiple sectors to drive digital transformation and innovation.

In Brazil , Amaris has grown year after year, reaching over 400 projects and collaborating with international clients from the US and Europe . Our consultants benefit from career development, ongoing training , and the flexibility to be reallocated across projects , ensuring exposure to diverse technologies and challenges.

We stand out for how we care about our people — through regular follow-ups, human-centered management, and a strong focus on professional growth.


Job description

We are looking for a SAP ABAP Developer to join our remote team and support international projects. The ideal candidate will have strong technical experience in SAP development tools and the ability to communicate fluently in English while collaborating with global teams.


Your missions

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance SAP applications using ABAP.
  • Design and implement solutions using: Fiori, IDOCs, APIs, SmartForms , SAPscript , and Adobe Forms
  • Build and optimize Reports , Dynamic Developments , Excel Creations , and ALV Reports .
  • Develop and maintain Methods and Classes in line with project standards.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to translate business requirements into efficient technical solutions.
  • Ensure high-quality code and performance through testing and documentation.


Your profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Proven experience as a SAP ABAP Developer .
  • Fluent English (mandatory) — written and spoken.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to work independently in a remote setup.


Strong knowledge of:

  • Fiori , IDOCs , APIs , SmartForms , SAPscript , Adobe Forms , Reports , ALV , and OO ABAP .
  • Good understanding of SAP modules and integration processes.



What we offer

  • International exposure with clients in Europe and the US .
  • A human-centered culture focused on career growth and development.
  • Access to training programs and mentoring opportunities through Amaris Academy.
  • Flexibility to work remotely with a dynamic and multicultural team.

title: Oracle Cloud Senior Functional Consultant
description:
About the Role

Genesis Consulting is expanding its Oracle Cloud Financials capability and seeks a Senior Functional Consultant with strong expertise across multiple financial modules — including Receivables, Payables, General Ledger, and Assets — to support complex enterprise environments. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a senior functional lead across financial modules, supporting both operational and strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure service excellence across multiple geographies, meeting compliance and performance standards.
  • Advise business leaders on best practices and process harmonization within Oracle Cloud Financials.
  • Coordinate global month-end close and reporting processes.
  • Mentor junior consultants and contribute to process governance.


Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience with Oracle ERP applications, with at least 5-7 years of hands-on experience within Oracle ERP/Fusion Cloud.
  • Hands-on and demonstrable experience and knowledge of core Oracle Financial modules, including Localizations for Brazil.
  • Excellent understanding of Financial Reporting requirements and practices.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to speak in both Portuguese and English.
  • Committed team player who is willing to share, learn and support fellow team members.
  • Ability to be proactive and take initiative.


Education :

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, or related field.


Other:

  • Finance/Accounting background is ideal.
  • English Mandatory.


Why Join Genesis

At Genesis Consulting, you’ll be part of a high-performance environment that values collaboration, ownership, and excellence. Work alongside experts in AI, Business Agility, and Enterprise Transformation to shape the future of digital consulting.

title: Social Sciences SME (Portuguese) - 47319
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview

We are looking for accomplished Tutors and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to contribute their expertise in Social Sciences, Humanities, and STEM disciplines . In this role, you will design, evaluate, and review advanced academic tasks that test critical thinking, reasoning, and subject mastery . Your input will directly help improve AI models by ensuring they can handle complex, graduate-level questions across disciplines.


What You’ll Do

  • Create structured, graduate-level tasks, prompts, and problem sets in your area of expertise.
  • Contribute to fields including Social Sciences, Humanities (history, literature, philosophy, etc.), and STEM (math, physics, biology, engineering, computer science, etc.).
  • Quality assurance: Assess AI-generated outputs for accuracy, depth, and rigor.
  • Pinpoint where models fail to reason correctly and provide expert corrections.
  • Maintain clear, organized records of tasks, solutions, and evaluations.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, or Postdoctoral experience) in your field of expertise.
  • Strong subject knowledge in one or more disciplines within Social Sciences, Humanities, or STEM.
  • Excellent academic writing and analytical skills.
  • Ability to design structured, verifiable assessment questions.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Perks of Freelancing with Turing:

  • Work on the cutting edge of AI.
  • Fully remote and flexible work environment.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and insight into how they’re trained.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: minimum 20 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative


Park Evaluations is a leading business immigration services firm focused on providing global corporations and law firms with the tools, guidance, and support needed to navigate a range of U.S. immigration processes and applications.


We are seeking a highly motivated and bilingual Business Development Representative to join our dynamic sales team. As a key player in our growth strategy, you will be responsible for generating qualified leads and scheduling product demos through proactive outreach and strategic engagement.


This is a fully remote position. Spoken and written proficiency in English is required for this role as you will be working with U.S.-based team members as well as English-speaking clients.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Make 50–75 outbound calls daily to prospective clients across various industries.
  • Utilize CRM software to manage and execute multi-touch outreach sequences including emails, calls, and LinkedIn messages.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all prospect interactions and activities in the CRM.
  • Schedule a minimum of one product demo per day by identifying and qualifying potential customers.
  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Marketing to optimize lead generation strategies.
  • Continuously refine messaging and outreach tactics based on performance data and feedback.
  • Represent the company with professionalism and enthusiasm in all communications.


Qualifications:

  • 1–2 years of experience in a sales or business development role
  • Proficiency (spoken and written) in English.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with a strong ability to craft compelling outreach messages.
  • Proven ability to deliver engaging presentations and articulate value propositions clearly.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (e.g., Zoho, Hubspot, Apollo or similar).
  • Self-starter with a strong work ethic and a passion for sales and business development.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

title: SAP Project Manager LATAM
description:
Sobre a Mouts

Entregamos soluções personalizadas que impulsionam a transformação digital dos nossos clientes de forma ágil, eficaz e inovadora. Acreditamos que a tecnologia é um agente de mudança capaz de simplificar a vida das pessoas e gerar valor real para os negócios.


Posição: Gerente de Projetos Sênior – SAP

Buscamos um(a) Gerente de Projetos Sênior SAP para liderar projetos de implementação e migração SAP S/4HANA em toda a região LATAM. Esse(a) profissional será responsável por planejar, coordenar e garantir a entrega de projetos complexos, dentro dos prazos, escopos e orçamentos definidos assegurando alta qualidade, governança e satisfação do cliente, com base nas melhores práticas da metodologia SAP Activate.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de implementação e migração SAP S/4HANA em diferentes países da América Latina.
  • Gerenciar cronogramas, recursos, riscos e comunicação com stakeholders locais e globais.
  • Aplicar a metodologia SAP Activate em todas as fases do projeto, assegurando a utilização correta das ferramentas e o cumprimento de Quality Gates, SAP ALM e demais requerimentos.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores externos.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas corporativas, regulatórias e de segurança da informação.
  • Elaborar e apresentar status reports executivos para a alta liderança (C-Level).
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre as áreas de negócio e TI, promovendo alinhamento estratégico e eficiência operacional.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em projetos de migração S/4HANA .
  • Certificação SAP Activate (obrigatória) .
  • Histórico comprovado na entrega de projetos SAP S/4HANA em ambientes complexos e de grande porte.
  • Vivência em projetos multinacionais , preferencialmente na região LATAM .
  • Espanhol fluente.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação e gestão de conflitos .
  • Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais .
  • Certificações adicionais em gerenciamento de projetos (ITIL, Scrum, PMI, PRINCE2, etc.) emitidas por instituições reconhecidas.
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Mudanças Organizacionais (OCM) .


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com clientes LATAM fora do Brasil.
  • Familiaridade com soluções SAP complementares (SuccessFactors, Ariba, entre outras).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Azure DevOps, SAP ALM, MS Project).
  • Vivência em grandes corporações multinacionais.
  • Histórico comprovado de projetos rentáveis e com alto índice de satisfação do cliente.

Esse(a) profissional será responsável por planejar, coordenar e garantir a entrega de projetos complexos, dentro dos prazos, escopos e orçamentos definidos assegurando alta qualidade, governança e satisfação do cliente, com base nas melhores práticas da metodologia SAP Activate.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de implementação e migração SAP S/4HANA em diferentes países da América Latina.
  • Gerenciar cronogramas, recursos, riscos e comunicação com stakeholders locais e globais.
  • Aplicar a metodologia SAP Activate em todas as fases do projeto, assegurando a utilização correta das ferramentas e o cumprimento de Quality Gates, SAP ALM e demais requerimentos.
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares e fornecedores externos.
  • Garantir conformidade com políticas corporativas, regulatórias e de segurança da informação.
  • Elaborar e apresentar status reports executivos para a alta liderança (C-Level).
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre as áreas de negócio e TI, promovendo alinhamento estratégico e eficiência operacional.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em projetos de migração S/4HANA .
  • Certificação SAP Activate (obrigatória) .
  • Histórico comprovado na entrega de projetos SAP S/4HANA em ambientes complexos e de grande porte.
  • Vivência em projetos multinacionais , preferencialmente na região LATAM .
  • Espanhol fluente.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança, comunicação e gestão de conflitos .
  • Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais .
  • Certificações adicionais em gerenciamento de projetos (ITIL, Scrum, PMI, PRINCE2, etc.) emitidas por instituições reconhecidas.
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Mudanças Organizacionais (OCM) .


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com clientes LATAM fora do Brasil.
  • Familiaridade com soluções SAP complementares (SuccessFactors, Ariba, entre outras).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Azure DevOps, SAP ALM, MS Project).
  • Vivência em grandes corporações multinacionais.
  • Histórico comprovado de projetos rentáveis e com alto índice de satisfação do cliente.

title: Game Designer (Mid to Senior)
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil-based) 

Employment type: Full-time (CLT) 

Language: Portuguese (fluent), English (professional working proficiency)

Salary Range:  R$7K – R$12K

762 Interactive is looking for a Game Designer to join our studio and help bring to life Project Kingpin, an ambitious and fresh take on crime-strategy and management games. We’re searching for someone with strong gameplay instincts, creative systems thinking, and a passion for designing mechanics that are strategic, rewarding, and authentic. You’ll work across gameplay systems, economy, and progression to shape how players experience the world we are building. This role requires both hands-on design work and collaboration across disciplines.


This is a remote position.

Please do not apply if you do not have prior game development experience.  

In This Role You Will:

  • Design and document core gameplay systems, loops, and progression structures.
  • Balance player rewards, pacing, and progression using data and playtesting.
  • Write and maintain clear design documentation (GDDs, feature briefs, tuning sheets).
  • Collaborate closely with developers, artists, and production to prototype and refine mechanics.
  • Participate in playtests and iterate based on player feedback.
  • Contribute ideas across mission design, economy systems, and player experience.
  • Help define design processes and best practices as part of a growing studio.


What We are Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Proven experience with gameplay systems, progression, or balancing.
  • Strong analytical thinking and ability to translate creative ideas into testable mechanics.
  • Proficiency with Excel/Sheets for tuning and balancing.
  • Knowledge of Unity editor & autonomy to use the scriptable objects
  • Clear, structured writing and documentation skills.
  • Can think and work creatively while taking the initiative to solve problems. 
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-discipline. 
  • Self-motivated, strong work ethic, and able to work independently. 
  • Drive towards professional growth. 
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency for daily communication with U.S. leadership.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with strategy / sim / management games is very welcome. 
  • UI/UX Design Experience.
  • Knowledge of C# in the Unity Engine.
  • Knowledge of AI behavior, or mission scripting.
  • Understanding of Unity implementation or prototyping workflows.
  • Interest in narrative-driven systems or branching gameplay.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary 
  • CLT Contract with Benefits (including Health Insurance, Monthly Meal Voucher, & Monthly Internet / Home Office Voucher)  
  • Remote-first culture 
  • Clear growth path: opportunities to advance your career as we scale the team and build the studio. 
  • Opportunity to shape the foundation of the studio and game from the ground up. 
  • Creative environment where your voice and ideas matter.

title: .NET Core Developer - Advanced English - Remote
description:
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 227,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering and cloud, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2022 totaled $12.1 billion.


To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Key Responsibilities:

1. Full Stack Development :

- Design, develop, and maintain both front-end and back-end code using .NET Core/ASP.NET , C# , JavaScript , and related technologies.

- Build interactive, responsive, and dynamic user interfaces using HTML5 , CSS3 , JavaScript , and modern front-end frameworks (e.g., React , Angular , or Vue.js ).

- Implement RESTful APIs and integrate with front-end UI for a seamless user experience.

2. Database Management :

- Design, develop, and optimize database structures using SQL Server or other relational databases.

- Write efficient SQL queries, stored procedures, and ensure database performance and scalability.

3. Collaboration :

- Work closely with other developers, designers, and product managers to ensure that the applications meet business requirements and deliver a high-quality user experience.

- Participate in code reviews, providing feedback on design and implementation, and following best practices for development.

4. Troubleshooting and Debugging :

- Identify and fix software defects and performance issues across the entire stack.

- Optimize both front-end performance (e.g., load times) and back-end efficiency (e.g., query optimization, scalability).

5. Testing and Documentation :

- Write unit tests and perform integration testing to ensure high code quality and stability.

- Maintain detailed documentation for codebase, APIs, and deployment processes.

6. Agile Development :

- Participate in Agile methodologies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and methodologies.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

- Strong proficiency in .NET Core , ASP.NET , and C# .

- Expertise in front-end technologies such as HTML5 , CSS3 , JavaScript , and front-end frameworks like React , Angular , or Vue.js .

- Solid experience working with relational databases like SQL Server .

- Familiarity with version control tools like Git .

- Experience with RESTful API development and integration.

- Strong understanding of web security principles and best practices.

- Knowledge of cloud platforms like Azure or AWS is a plus.

- Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker ) and CI/CD pipelines is desirable.

Preferred Skills:

- Experience with front-end build tools and task runners (e.g., Webpack , Gulp ).

- Knowledge of Microservices architecture .

- Exposure to other back-end technologies like Node.js is a plus.

- Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

title: UX Writer - Remoto (Exclusiva PCD)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: UX Writer - Remoto (Exclusiva PCD).


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência em UX Writing/Content Design.
  • Experiência com produtos digitais.
  • Domínio do Figma.

  • Domínio dos princípios e boas práticas de UX Writing/Content Design, acessibilidade e design centrado no usuário.
  • Habilidade com arquitetura de informação e Design de Interação.
  • Familiaridade com protótipos (alta e baixa fidelidade) e wireframes.
  • Habilidade em produzir documentação, guias e templates.
  • Experiência com avaliação heurística.
  • Facilidade em simplificar o entendimento de conteúdos difíceis e traduzir termos técnicos.
  • Graduação em Publicidade, Jornalismo, Letras ou disciplina correlata (preferencialmente).

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

title: Desenvolvedor Pega
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.


Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.


Buscamos uma pessoa Desenvolvedor(a) Pega para nos apoiar em um projeto estratégico junto com uma equipe de analistas e desenvolvedores.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e customizar aplicações na plataforma Pega, conforme os requisitos de negócios.
  • Colaborar com analistas de negócios, arquitetos e outros desenvolvedores para traduzir requisitos funcionais em soluções técnicas.
  • Realizar o design, codificação, teste e depuração de aplicativos Pega, seguindo as melhores práticas e padrões da empresa.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico para a resolução de problemas e otimização de desempenho das aplicações Pega.
  • Contribuir para a documentação técnica e manutenção de registros precisos do desenvolvimento de software.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência comprovada de (1-3) anos em desenvolvimento utilizando Pega.
  • Conhecimento sólido em design de regras, processos de negócio e arquitetura de aplicação na plataforma Pega.
  • Certificação Pega CSA (Certified System Architect) ou superior é desejável.
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes e capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas.


Diferenciais da oportunidade:


  • Experiência em integrações com sistemas legados e/ou com plataformas de CRM ou BPM.
  • Certificação adicional em Pega CSSA (Certified Senior System Architect).
  • Conhecimento em automação de processos de negócios (RPA) e/ou ferramentas de gerenciamento de casos.


Benefícios:


  • CLT
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • VR/VA – (Caju – cartão de crédito para uso flexível de alimentação)
  • Notebook da Empresa
  • Desconto em aulas particulares de Inglês e espanhol
  • Descontos em Graduação e MBA em faculdade parceira
  • Acesso aos cursos da Udemy
  • Bleasure (Extensão de viagens de negócios para descanso)
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR)
  • Treinamentos Periódicos e incentivo ao estudo com acesso a diversas certificações
  • Ambiente que promove a inovação, autonomia, descontraído e colaborativo


Modelo de trabalho:


  • Remoto com possibilidade de eventualmente ir ao cliente ou no escritório da Practia em SP/SP.

title: Senior Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom WordPress plugins and themes from scratch using PHP, MySQL, and modern best practices.
  • Implement advanced custom fields (ACF) , custom post types , and taxonomies for structured data management.
  • Optimize database queries and improve performance across complex WordPress sites (meta queries, caching, indexing).
  • Integrate WordPress with third-party APIs and automation tools (REST, webhook systems, Make/Zapier, Algolia, etc.).
  • Develop and maintain cron jobs , background tasks, and data synchronization scripts.
  • Build and maintain Gutenberg blocks or React-based admin components when required.
  • Ensure sites meet performance, accessibility, and SEO standards (Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, DevOps, QA, design) following Agile practices.
  • Write clean, well-documented, and unit-tested code following OOP principles and WordPress coding standards.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.
  • Strong proficiency in PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript .
  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.
  • Proficient in ACF , CPT UI , Gutenberg , and WooCommerce .
  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .
  • Experience with performance optimization , caching mechanisms, and scalable WordPress architectures.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Senior Wordpress Developer
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience , focusing on backend and custom plugin work.

  • Experience with WordPress hooks (actions & filters) , custom queries, and optimization strategies.

  • Solid understanding of WordPress REST API , webhooks , and API integrations .
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines .

title: Staff Accountant (Netsuite)
description:
SUMMARY


INTUS Windows is seeking a detail-oriented and systems-savvy NetSuite Accountant to manage the entry, accuracy, and validation of accounting data within our NetSuite ERP platform. This role plays a key part in supporting Finance and Accounting operations by ensuring clean, consistent, and well-tested financial data across all core accounting modules — including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), and Payroll.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in accounting, hands-on experience with NetSuite, and enjoys working in a structured, process-driven environment. This position is responsible for data entry, testing, reconciliations, and configuration validation within the NetSuite system.


PERFORMANCE OBJECTIVES


NetSuite Accounting Data Management


  • Enter and validate accounting-related data in NetSuite.
  • Ensure completeness and accuracy of all accounting entries in NetSuite across AR, AP, GL, and Payroll modules.
  • Conduct regular audits to identify and correct data inconsistencies or configuration issues.
  • Support daily transactional entry, adjustments, and posting of journal entries under supervision.


Testing & System Validation


  • Assist in testing accounting processes across NetSuite modules:
  • Validate system workflows for AP, AR, GL, Fixed Assets, and Payroll.
  • Perform UAT (User Acceptance Testing) during NetSuite updates or enhancements.
  • Work closely with the Accounting, Finance, and IT teams to identify and troubleshoot accounting-related system errors or configuration gaps.
  • Help document testing procedures and results for audit and compliance purposes.


Month-End & Operational Support


  • Support the month-end close process by preparing, verifying, and entering journal entries in NetSuite.
  • Assist in reconciling general ledger accounts and running reports to support financial review.
  • Ensure system data is closed and locked appropriately in accordance with internal deadlines.


Documentation & Internal Support


  • Maintain accurate documentation of system processes, data input standards, and workflows within NetSuite.
  • Assist accounting team members in navigating NetSuite functionality and resolving data entry issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of NetSuite accounting procedures and controls.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.


KEY COMPETENCIES


  • Strong working knowledge of NetSuite ERP and accounting module navigation.
  • Understanding of US GAAP accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative accounting team.
  • Capable of managing multiple tasks in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting data manipulation.
  • Effective communication and organizational skills.


EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of accounting experience, with 2+ years of hands-on strong experience in NetSuite ERP.
  • Solid understanding of general accounting functions including journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
  • Experience working with accounting data across modules like AR, AP, GL, and Payroll.


WHAT WE OFFER


  • Remote work opportunity.
  • Working hours 8-5 EST (preferred).
  • Monthly gross salary within the range of $1000-$2200.
  • Participating in our "One Window - One Tree" initiative.
  • The opportunity to improve your skills through professional development training.
  • A rapidly growing company.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.

title: Chatbot Developer Pleno
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Responsável por desenvolver e manter chatbots em diferentes plataformas, com foco em JavaScript e Python.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Manutenção Multi-Plataforma: Atuar na sustentação, troubleshooting e correção de bugs de chatbots desenvolvidos e implantados nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Evolução Rasa: Manter e evoluir a estrutura do framework Rasa, incluindo as custom actions, o deploy e, principalmente, os pipelines de NLU e as stories complexas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura Rasa: Gerenciar e manter o ambiente de deploy do bot em Rasa, garantindo o bom funcionamento e a estabilidade.
  • Integrações: Utilizar integrações de back-end (APIs, Webhooks) para o funcionamento dos fluxos em ambas as plataformas.
  • Qualidade Conversacional e Métricas: Trabalhar com a curadoria, refinando modelos de NLP/NLU. Além disso, definir e monitorar métricas de performance conversacional (ex: Intent Accuracy, Fallback Rate, Tempo de Resposta), propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Código e Padrões: Escrever e manter código limpo, testável e bem documentado, especialmente nas custom actions do Rasa (Python) e nos scripts do BLiP (JavaScript/Node.js).
  • Versionamento e CI/CD: Garantir o controle de versão com Git e auxiliar na manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD para automação do deploy do bot.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação técnica da arquitetura, integrações e procedimentos de manutenção.


Requisitos e qualificações


É imprescindível que você tenha:


  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e, principalmente, na sustentação (manutenção) de chatbots nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python e JavaScript/Node.js.
  • Domínio na utilização (consumo) de APIs REST/RESTful e Webhooks.
  • Conhecimento em NLP/NLU (treinamento, curadoria e fine-tuning de Intents e Entities).
  • Experiência com Git e familiaridade com conceitos de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática com Docker.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL).
  • Resolução de Problemas (Troubleshooting): Capacidade analítica para identificar, diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos em produção de forma eficaz.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum e/ou Kanban.


Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:

  • Experiência com curadoria de dados conversacionais e otimização do dataset de treinamento.
  • Domínio na criação de APIs REST/RESTful do zero.
  • Conhecimento e experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis) para armazenamento de contexto e dados conversacionais.
  • Familiaridade com orquestração de containers (ex: Kubernetes) para deploy de Rasa em escala.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering e integração de Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) em fluxos de chatbot.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) para hospedagem de serviços de apoio.


Informações adicionais


Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)
  • Assistência Odontológica (Bradesco)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) – com extensão para até 3 dependentes
  • Telemedicina 24h – consultas online por chamada de vídeo, disponíveis todos os dias da semana
  • Isenção na mensalidade do SEM PARAR – para 1 veículo no plano Tag Imparável
  • Vale-Alimentação ou Vale-Refeição – você escolhe a melhor opção:
  • VA para compras em supermercados
  • VR para uso em restaurantes no dia a dia
  • Day-off de aniversário (pessoal e da empresa)
  • Programa de acompanhamento para gestantes e licença-paternidade estendida
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio-Creche
  • Auxílio para dependente PCD

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Java Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 53201


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


O que você deve ter?


- Domínio em Java (8+) e ecossistema Spring (Boot, Data, Security, Cloud, Batch, MVC);

- Conhecimento em Design Patterns e princípios SOLID;

- Experiência com arquitetura em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), incluindo uso de serviços como ECS, EKS, Lambda, S3 ou CloudWatch;

- Vivência com mensageria e filas (RabbitMQ, Kafka, SQS, SNS) para integração entre sistemas e processamento assíncrono;

- Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Redis);

- Prática em CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) e versionamento com Git;

- Experiência com conteinerização e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados (JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, integração e performance);

- Desejável: conhecimento em NodeJS para integrações leves, APIs RESTful e documentação com Swagger/OpenAPI;

- Experiência com observabilidade e monitoramento (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk) será um diferencial;


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: PRODUCT DESIGN MANAGER
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?


A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.


Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.


Nossa cultura:


Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:


⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.


Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.


No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Liderança Técnica Java
description:
Você é um(a) Líder Técnico(a) Java em busca de novos desafios e um ambiente acolhedor e colaborativo? Então essa oportunidade é para você!


Na CWI Software, acreditamos que o sucesso de nossos projetos está diretamente ligado ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores. Por isso, oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, com oportunidades de crescimento profissional e valorização da cultura da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência como liderança técnica, Java 17+, vivência em projetos de PIX
  • Ferramentas de testes como JUnit e Mockito;
  • Uso de frameworks como Spring Boot;
  • Práticas de qualidade com Sonar, arquitetura de microserviços e sistemas distribuídos;
  • Atuação com diversos serviços da AWS, como: S3, Glacier, Cognito, SQS, ECS, VPC, Lambda e API Gateway;
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados relacionais (DB2 e PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (DynamoDB e MongoDB);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento, tais como New Relic, Dynatrace e Datadog.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders


Why this role

We’re hunting for product–market fit . That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren’t afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun , ask “why ” before “how ,” and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.


So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.


What you’ll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the “why,” define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.


Outcomes (how we’ll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops : each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.


You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node , Python , React/Next ; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data : logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don’t need a JIRA novella to start building.


Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).


Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control


How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.


Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.

  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, “why before what.”


Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact .
